shell_commands:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch
sed -n '1,220p' src/transport/ws/conversationListHandler.test.ts
sed -n '1,260p' specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md
sed -n '1,260p' specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md
sed -n '1,220p' .lore/test-commands.yml
rg -n \"reanchor|spec-links|sessionResume\" scripts package.json"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "cat ../round-brief.md
rg -n \"list_sessions|session_list\" specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md src/transport/ws/validation.ts src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts src/types/session.ts
rg -n \"createdAt|updatedAt\" src/types/session.ts
rg --files scripts | rg 'reanchor'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,180p' src/types/session.ts
sed -n '390,570p' src/transport/sessionResume.test.ts
rg -n \"resume off|latestFor answers|no resumeFailure|still completes|starts a new session|sends no resumeFailure\" specs/hal-engine-session-resume/spec.md
sed -n '270,390p' specs/hal-engine-session-resume/spec.md
cat package.json | sed -n '1,100p'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npm run spec:names:fix
git diff --stat
git diff -- src/transport/ws/conversationListHandler.test.ts specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md specs/hal-engine-session-resume/spec.md .lore/dod.md'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/transport/ws/conversationListHandler.test.ts specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md specs/hal-engine-session-resume/spec.md .lore/dod.md
npm run spec:names:fix
git diff --check
git status --short'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md specs/hal-engine-session-resume/spec.md specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md src/transport/ws/conversationListHandler.test.ts && git commit -m "Document WebSocket conversation lists" && git push origin HEAD && git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
